scope: Read-only current snapshot of known Stage 3 probe paths; no signal, build, cleanup, or product reclamation performed.

process_observation.method: ps process enumeration, current UID filter, known probe-root command/executable path match, libproc executable and microsecond birth observation where available
process_observation.interpretation: No matching command or executable was observed at this instant if count is zero. This is not an identity-complete process-tree emptiness proof and cannot discover renamed or unrecorded historical descendants.

new_vs_historical.known_task_artifacts: The listed Stage 3 research work directories were created during this task and intentionally retained for reproduction/debugging. They are not reclaimed product resources.
new_vs_historical.product_registered_resource_inventory: not_available_on_macos; no claim about historical cross-platform registered or unregistered resources
new_vs_historical.reclamation_success: not_claimed; fixture self-exit, wait/reap, test-directed termination, and retained build caches are not product reclamation

limitations: No kernel-owned execution container exists for these probes.
A current process snapshot cannot establish all historical process ownership or count new versus pre-existing resources.
Directories outside the known Stage 3 root and historical sandbox resource ledgers were not audited.
Dynamic process and directory counts describe capture time only.
